# `bin/claim-deps`

A tool: run it from the root of an instance (or of the kit, for the kit's own tools).
Source: [`bin/claim-deps`](../../../bin/claim-deps)

## What it says about itself

```text
bin/claim-deps [C-NNN ...]   (read-only; LESSONS.md "Dependencies between ledger entries are read by bytes and by name")

Dependencies between CLAIMS.md entries. X depends on Y when Y's artifact (by sha256) is X's artifact or one of
X's deps ("file"), when X's statement or silent links name Y ("names"), or when X's Premises line lists Y as a
ledger premise ("premise"). Notes are not read.
  no argument   every live entry that depends directly on a superseded entry (a file restated under a live
                entry counts as the live entry's; an entry's own predecessor is not listed)
  C-NNN ...     for each: what it depends on, and every entry that depends on it (with depth), marked live or
                superseded
Exit 0 always: this is a report, never a block. bin/close-run and bin/ledger-claims print the same dependents
for any id a claim supersedes.
```

## Lessons it cites

- → **Dependencies between ledger entries are read by bytes and by name**

## Ledger events it writes

None.
